Shroomish

Grass

Hoenn · Generation 3

Shroomish is a Grass-type Mushroom Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 4.5 kg. It evolves into Breloom. Its highest base stat is HP (60), with a base stat total of 295.
